name: job_output
description: Fetch the result or current status of a background job or a user job by its `job_id`. For agent jobs (`job_...`) it returns the result plus recent output when settled, or a running status with the output tail. For user jobs (`ujob_...`) it returns the user's report when completed, or a status line. This call never blocks; use job_wait to wait.

job_id.description: The job id (e.g. job_... returned by a background workflow, or ujob_... returned by request_user_job).

prompt: job_output: read the result or status of a background job (`job_...`) or a user job (`ujob_...`). Returns the result plus recent output when settled, otherwise a status line.
